page.title: Quotes
page.description: Price up work, send it for approval, and track what gets accepted.

open.title: No open quotes
open.description: Drafts and quotes awaiting a customer response will show up here.

expired.title: Nothing expired
expired.description: Quotes that lapse without an answer land here — revive or re-quote them.

accepted.title: No accepted quotes yet
accepted.description: Quotes your customers say yes to will appear here.

all.title: No quotes yet
all.description: Price up your first job and send it for the customer to accept.

noMatch.title: No quotes match
noMatch.description: Try a different search or clear some filters.

stats.withCustomers: {count, plural, one {# quote with customers} other {# quotes with customers}}
stats.withCustomersExpiring: {count, plural, one {# quote with customers} other {# quotes with customers}} · {expiring} expiring soon
stats.acceptedAllTime: {count, plural, one {# quote accepted all time} other {# quotes accepted all time}}
stats.winRateDetail: {accepted} of {decided, plural, one {# decided quote} other {# decided quotes}}, last 90 days
stats.noDecided: No decided quotes in the last 90 days

list.searchLabel: Search quotes by number, title or contact name

row.callRequest: Quote request from a call — price it up

noneSelected.title: No quote selected
noneSelected.description: Select a quote to see its details.

notFound.title: Quote not found
notFound.description: This quote doesn't exist or was removed.

detail.title: Quote {number}
detail.noItemsFromCall: No line items yet — this request came in from a call. Edit the draft to price it up.
detail.noItems: No line items yet — edit the draft to add them.

form.editDescription: Drafts stay editable until you send them.
form.newDescription: Price up the work, then send it for the customer to accept.
form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: What the quote is for, e.g. Kitchen rewire
form.validUntilHint: Left blank, sending sets it {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the issue date.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What will be done or supplied

deposit.percentHint: Whole percent of the quote total.
deposit.amountHint: Amount in shekels payable to commence.

form.notesPlaceholder: Shown to the customer on the quote (optional)
form.termsPlaceholder: Scope of work, exclusions, payment terms…
form.internalNotesPlaceholder: Pricing workings, call details — never shown to the customer

sendDialog.title: Send quote {number}
sendDialog.description: Emails {customer} a quote for {amount} with a link to accept online. {dates}
sendDialog.datesIssuedNoValid: Issued {issued}, valid until {days, plural, one {# day later} other {# days later}}.
sendDialog.datesUnset: The issue date will be set to today and the quote stays valid {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
sendDialog.noEmailAlert: {name} has no email address on file. You can still send — the quote goes live and you share its link by text or in person.

resendDialog.reviveDescription: Puts the quote back in front of the customer with a fresh validity window.
resendDialog.resendDescription: Sends the customer another email with the same accept link.
resendDialog.validUntilPlaceholder: {days, plural, one {# day from today} other {# days from today}}
resendDialog.validUntilHint: Left blank, the quote stays valid {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} from today.

acceptDialog.title: Mark quote {number} as accepted?
acceptDialog.description: Records that {customer} accepted the {amount} quote. You can then convert it to an invoice.
acceptDialog.descriptionExpired: Records that {customer} accepted the {amount} quote (even though it had expired). You can then convert it to an invoice.

declineDialog.title: Mark quote {number} as declined
declineDialog.description: Records that {customer} turned down the {amount} quote. Declined is final — duplicate the quote to re-price the work.
declineDialog.reasonHint: Optional — why the customer said no.

convertDialog.title: Convert quote {number} to an invoice?
convertDialog.description: Drafts an invoice for {amount} with the same line items and tax rates, ready to review and send to {customer}. A quote converts once.

convertToJobDialog.title: Convert quote {number} to a job?
convertToJobDialog.description: Creates a job worth {amount} (ex. tax) with the same line items, ready to schedule for {customer}. A quote converts once — the quote stays here with its history.

voidDialog.title: Void quote {number}?
voidDialog.description: Withdraws the {amount} quote for {customer} — their link stops accepting. The quote stays on record but can't be reopened.

deleteDialog.title: Delete draft {number}?
deleteDialog.description: The draft and its line items are removed for good. This can't be undone.

toasts.sentNoEmail: Quote {number} is live, but no email went out — copy the link to share it.
toasts.resentNoEmail: Quote {number} is live again, but no email went out — copy the link to share it.
toasts.convertedToJob: {job} created from quote {quote} — book it in
toasts.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — the link is shown in your browser at {url}
